current_scope: Priority1 only: actual model correction of an exposed invalid proposal and truthful reporting of that correction. No general financial strategy approval.

historical_trigger.final_false_claim: the initial allocation already satisfied the sum-to-one constraint
historical_trigger.meaning: The failure was not loss of calculator messages. Correctly delivered invalid feedback did not lead to numerical correction, and final narrative contradicted the trace.

required_separation: feedback actually visible to the next model call
model explanation truthfully describes earlier error and later state
not_equivalent: forcing a benchmark or equal-weight target

allowed_online_information: The same already-visible public source packet, common market data and task rules.
The unmodified previous model raw proposal and its actual calculator result, with stage/call identifiers and hashes recorded outside the model text.
A neutral current-task instruction to reconcile the observed calculator status, revise or explicitly leave unresolved, and avoid claiming success contrary to evidence.

A clarification that nested market_diagnostics.status=ok concerns the supplied market object, while allocation.valid=false and null baseline/risk mean no valid proposed-portfolio diagnostic was produced. Preserve the original feedback bytes.
prohibited_online_information: Evaluator-only annotation files, original source pages absent from the public packet, source-label answer tables, offline human/assistant semantic verdicts, or held-out main outputs.

A corrected vector, a sector selected by the runner to receive missing mass, normalizing coefficients applied to the submitted output, forced equal weighting, or a benchmark target substituted for a model decision.
An optimizer solution, arbitrary institution risk cap/gamma, confidence requirement, quality score or success-conditioned best-of-run selector.

registered_episode_requirement.eligible_episode: An independently verified invalid raw proposal precedes a subsequent model request that visibly contains its actual negative calculator feedback; the next proposal is stored unchanged and recalculated.
registered_episode_requirement.if_all_new_proposals_start_valid: Record feasibility or prevention, but actual correction ability is not observed. Do not label an unexercised repair gate passed.
registered_episode_requirement.known_failure_replay_candidate: The already stored v4.5 final raw proposal and genuine calculator result may be preregistered as a development replay input. This is not a new institution sample or an untouched confirmation case. No synthetic correct answer is added.
registered_episode_requirement.if_natural_failure_occurs_in_fixed_workf: Review the captured transition within that registered workflow without resampling until a convenient failure/success appears.
registered_episode_requirement.case_identity: Keep the predetermined Fidelity Q2/R1 development case unless a separate pre-run change records the rationale. No successful case substitution.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: The registered correction episode is actually observed, with an invalid raw predecessor and its corresponding feedback visible before revision.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: User requested feedback uptake; detection, uptake and repair are distinct observations, not a new numeric score.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: The final raw allocation contains exactly one row for every one of the existing11 canonical sector codes, with finite numeric weights in the original long-only full-investment domain.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: Existing task contract and evaluation_spec, not a new target allocation.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: The independently recomputed raw sum meets the existing sum criterion and every existing supported documented constraint used in this scope is evaluated against the unrepaired model output.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: Existing engine precision rule; no threshold selected after outcomes.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: The current final state and stated correction agree: an earlier invalid proposal is not described as originally valid; claimed weight changes, if specified, occur in the raw values; success is not asserted when the calculator remains invalid.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: Trace-grounded factual correctness. No fixed ACK token, prose-length cutoff, rhetorical checklist or confidence score.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: No automatic normalization, clipping, projection, cash imputation, answer repair, source/gold feedback, hidden retry or best-output selection produces the accepted vector.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: The target is model correction, not feasibility supplied by an external repair system.

priority1_acceptance_conditions.condition: Three named audits for this same terminal attempt and its exact artifact hashes are independently completed and all pass in their priority1 scopes.
priority1_acceptance_conditions.basis: Explicit user order. Passing one or two audits does not permit priority2.

mathematical_rules.sector_universe: Reuse evaluation_spec.taxonomy.codes_and_names;11 is the public task universe, not a newly optimized sample size.
mathematical_rules.precision_role: The inherited1e-6 is engineering serialization precision, not a paper-derived behavioral effect threshold. Report exact Decimal/Fraction sums and float-engine residuals separately.
mathematical_rules.long_only: 0<=w_s<=1 for every finite numeric raw weight; no negative-weight tolerance is added.
mathematical_rules.coverage: All11 canonical sectors once; zero weights explicit; duplicate/missing sectors remain invalid.
mathematical_rules.delta_record: For matching unique codes, report delta_s=w_revised,s-w_prior,s and sum(delta_s). These are descriptive correction traces, not a required sector-specific adjustment.
mathematical_rules.constraint_scope: Only task constraints and independently documented constraints genuinely visible at that stage. Arbitrary submitted bounds do not become true institutional mandates just because the calculator can process them.
mathematical_rules.rounding_claims: Judge a numerical assertion at its stated precision and against the existing disclosed tolerance; keep residuals explicit. Do not invent a new semantic tolerance or demand a literal exact-zero binary floating residual.

three_audits.name: execution_and_provenance
required_checks: Pre-run case, model/runtime, schema, reconciliation instruction, source/market and bounded call budget are registered and hashed.
The invalid predecessor, its calculator arguments/result, and later request are correctly paired and preserved.
Rendered prompt preserves the required inputs and preceding final assistant/calculator content; no hidden source reference enters the online path.
The model rather than the runner emits the revised vector; capture request, raw stream, completed response, termination, calls and all failures.
No automatic retry, normalization, clipping, projection, parser repair, overwrite, alternate model or silent case substitution occurred.
three_audits.pass_scope: A validly observed correction test; this round does not decide whether the vector or explanation is correct.

three_audits.name: independent_raw_arithmetic
required_checks: Read original raw JSON decimal literals and reject duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite/nonnumeric values.
Independently check public code completeness/uniqueness and original long-only bounds.
Recompute exact raw sums, residuals and sector-by-sector changes without importing a corrected vector from the runner.
Compare independent findings with recorded calculator output using the existing engineering tolerance only; disclose precision differences.
Verify the final model-authored vector is valid; retain prior invalid vectors and null unavailable financial diagnostics.
three_audits.pass_scope: The model-authored final vector satisfies the pre-existing priority1 arithmetic contract; no claim about optimal weights, source-label accuracy or expected returns.

three_audits.name: feedback_and_correction_claim_logic
required_checks: Locate the actual invalid-feedback episode and the new response that follows it.
Check error acknowledgment semantically against the original trace; no required ACK token or length metric.
Check each consequential correction/unchanged/success assertion against actual before/after values and calculator states.
Reject a final claim that the initial invalid vector already satisfied the budget, or that no issue remains when a raw violation persists.
Separate successful mathematical repair from unresolved source interpretation, market-value reporting and allocation rationale reserved for priorities2 and3.
three_audits.pass_scope: The correction description is truthful and the observed repair addresses the disclosed error; this is not blanket semantic or strategy approval.

gate_state_machine.transition_to_priority1_pass: Only after the same registered attempt is terminal and P1-A through P1-F all hold. Three individual PASS records and their input hashes are required.
gate_state_machine.advance_to_priority2: Permitted only after priority1_pass is recorded. Preserve the successful priority1 artifact as the baseline and separately preregister priority2 changes.
gate_state_machine.failure_handling: Remain at priority1, preserve all outputs and precise failing condition. A later prospective revision must be separately recorded; do not rewrite the failed answer or quietly continue to priority2.
gate_state_machine.uncertainty_handling: Missing trace evidence or unresolved reviewer disagreement is pending/fail-to-demonstrate, never automatic pass.
gate_state_machine.main: Forbidden under this request, even if priorities1-3 eventually pass. Preparation/review may reach the point immediately before main execution.

budget_and_retry_policy.status: Must be fixed in the separate run registration before any new generation.
budget_and_retry_policy.rule: Do not run an unbounded until-success loop or adopt the largest count after seeing outcomes. Distinguish model revision iterations, four workflow task stages, three audit rounds, and external attempt counts.
budget_and_retry_policy.numeric_limits: This review introduces no new retry count, time limit, token cap or behavioral cutoff. Existing limits may be retained as labeled engineering controls; any paper-derived candidate count must retain its original experimental meaning and adaptation limits.
budget_and_retry_policy.readiness: New implementation, fixtures and the exact proposed bounded trace remain to be reviewed; this file alone does not approve an unreviewed runner.

reporting_and_denominators.attempts: Keep v4.5 failure and all v4.6 prospective attempts in a versioned ledger. Report each attempted, completed, raw-valid, audit-passed and failed count.
reporting_and_denominators.source_extraction: Preserve existing final-source-label fixed denominator11 independently; an attempted missing final answer remains0/11 under that metric, while unobserved semantic claims remain null.
reporting_and_denominators.no_pooling: Do not count four stages or three audits as independent institution cases. Do not convert one known-failure repair into a general correction success rate.
reporting_and_denominators.scope_after_priority1_pass: Only actual raw feasibility repair and truthful correction reporting for the registered episode. Priority2 market-number/explanation issues and priority3 source-to-allocation reasoning remain unapproved.
reporting_and_denominators.study_connection: A trace showing detection, uptake and realized correction is relevant to the operational reliability of institution-conditioned sector-allocation workflows. It does not estimate institutional convergence or the R1/R4 treatment effect.

reference_basis.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
reference_basis.supports: Separate detection, candidate change and successful repair; keep interaction budgets and failed attempts explicit. ACK-required did not reliably improve results in its tested math setting.
reference_basis.limits: Different actors, exact-answer math and protocols; no guaranteed benefit for Qwen4B portfolio tasks. Mandatory ACK tokens are not adopted. The paper outer-attempt count is not silently equated with LIBERA task stages or audit rounds.

reference_basis.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
locators: section4.2, numerical details under separate primary-source review
reference_basis.supports: External tool interaction can inform model-authored critique and revision.
reference_basis.limits: Foundational ICLR2024 work, not a claim that its numeric iteration settings are optimal or directly transplanted here; no new correction count is inferred by this review.

reference_basis.title: OpenPM
reference_basis.supports: Keep raw adherence and post-critic feasibility distinct.
reference_basis.limits: Its projection/clipping/scaling repair is not adopted. External corrected feasibility would not demonstrate the model correction targeted here.

reference_basis.supports: Existing raw sum, finite-number, long-only, code-universe, no-repair and fixed-denominator rules; inherited precision tolerances are engineering definitions.
Existing supported/contradicted/not_stated/uncertain source review and separation of facts, decisions and missing outputs.

pre_run_checklist: Finalize bounded protocol and register before inference.
Test invalid feedback is actually visible and a schema-valid but financially invalid response cannot satisfy the final acceptance gate.
Test a financially valid vector with a false prior-success explanation cannot satisfy claim-logic audit.
Test external repair/gold access and dropped failed attempts are detected.
Test valid-first-pass without a correction episode is labeled repair-unobserved rather than repaired.
Do not test with live inference while implementation approval remains pending.
unresolved_before_execution: Exact proposed revised prompt/feedback wrapper and hashes.
Chosen bounded revision/task-stage budget and its source-versus-engineering labeling.
Whether the registered correction episode replays the known v4.5 failure or occurs within a fixed new workflow; the choice must precede generation.
Implementation and meaningful offline fixture verification.

reviewed_primary_basis_package.compatibility: The recommended first candidate preserves four existing task stages and adds explicit active-task error grounding plus external final acceptance. This is compatible with the priority1 audit gate. No paper-derived claim is made for four stages, the exact prompt, or Qwen4B efficacy.
reviewed_primary_basis_package.remaining_requirement: Actual correction needs an observed invalid-feedback episode; a valid-first-pass run alone remains repair-unobserved.
